blocks.text: Employment Contract
THIS EMPLOYMENT CONTRACT (hereinafter referred to as the “Contract”) is made and entered into on this 1st day of January, 2026.
BETWEEN:

(1) DocuA4 Test Co., a company duly organized and existing under the laws of Ethiopia, with its principal place of business at [Employer's Full Address, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia] (hereinafter referred to as the “Employer”);
AND

(2) Abebe Bekele, an Ethiopian national, holder of [ID Type, e.g., National ID] No. [Employee's ID Number], residing at [Employee's Full Address, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia] (hereinafter referred to as the “Employee”).
The Employer and the Employee are hereinafter collectively referred to as the “Parties” and individually as a “Party”.
RECITALS
WHEREAS, the Employer is engaged in the business of [Specify Nature of Employer's Business] and requires the services of personnel with the requisite skills and qualifications;
WHEREAS, the Employee represents that he/she possesses the necessary skills, qualifications, and experience to perform the duties required by the Employer;
WHEREAS, the Employer has agreed to employ the Employee, and the Employee has agreed to serve the Employer upon the terms and conditions hereinafter set forth;
NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants and agreements contained herein, the Parties agree as follows:
Article 1: Position and Duties
1.1. The Employer hereby employs the Employee in the capacity of [Specify Job Title, e.g., 'Accountant', 'Software Developer'].

1.2. The Employee shall perform all duties as are customarily associated with such position and any other duties as may be reasonably assigned by the Employer's management from time to time. A detailed job description may be provided separately.
Article 2: Term of Employment
2.1. This Contract shall commence on the effective date of January 1, 2026.
2.2. This Contract is for an indefinite period, subject to the probationary period and termination provisions outlined herein and in the relevant Ethiopian Labour Proclamation.
Article 3: Remuneration and Benefits
3.1. The Employer shall pay the Employee a monthly gross salary of [Specify Monthly Gross Salary in ETB], payable in arrears at the end of each calendar month.
3.2. All payments shall be subject to statutory deductions, including but not limited to income tax and pension contributions, as required by the laws of Ethiopia.
3.3. The Employee may be entitled to other benefits as per the Employer's internal policies and the Ethiopian Labour Proclamation.
Article 4: Working Hours and Place of Work
4.1. The Employee's normal working hours shall be in accordance with the Ethiopian Labour Proclamation, typically eight (8) hours per day and forty (40) hours per week.

4.2. The Employee's primary place of work shall be the Employer's office located in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. The Employer reserves the right to require the Employee to work at other locations as may be necessary for the proper performance of his/her duties.
Article 5: Leave

5.1. The Employee shall be entitled to annual leave, sick leave, public holidays, and other forms of leave in accordance with the minimum provisions stipulated in the prevailing Ethiopian Labour Proclamation and the Employer's human resources policy.
Article 6: Obligations of the Employee
Article 7: Obligations of the Employer
Article 8: Termination of Employment
8.1. This Contract may be terminated by either Party in accordance with the grounds and procedures set forth in the Ethiopian Labour Proclamation No. 1156/2019 (as amended).
8.2. The Party initiating the termination shall provide the other Party with a written notice as prescribed by law.
Article 9: Governing Law and Dispute Resolution
9.1. This Contract shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia.

9.2. Any dispute, controversy, or claim arising out of or relating to this Contract shall first be settled amicably between the Parties. If an amicable settlement cannot be reached, the dispute shall be resolved by the competent court of law in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia.
Article 10: Entire Agreement

10.1. This Contract constitutes the entire agreement between the Parties and supersedes all prior oral or written agreements, understandings, or arrangements relating to the subject matter hereof. Any amendment or modification to this Contract must be in writing and signed by both Parties.
IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Parties have executed this Employment Contract in two (2) original copies on the date first above written, with each Party retaining one copy.
